recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-37883 unless the work group later reopens the broader semantics of contained-resource search.
issue_request: FHIR-37883 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification asking that the core search page make clear that _contained controls whether contained resources are included as search result matches, not whether chained search conditions are evaluated inside contained resources.
initial_application: The change was applied in two explicit 2022-08-29 source commits, cb2679824f and 451cc74d06, which updated source/search.html to replace the ambiguous "this behavior" wording and add concrete MedicationRequest/Medication examples for returning contained resources or their containers.
additional_context: The active source/search.html section still separates default result behavior from chained evaluation, defines _contained values as searching and returning contained resources, and demonstrates _contained=true with _containedType=contained and _containedType=container. FHIR-I minutes for 2022-08-29 corroborate the Persuasive 12-0-0 vote, and no conflicting Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already resolves the ambiguity identified by the issue, and more prose would be redundant rather than a necessary specification correction.
